scientific_limitations: Diffusivity is independent of Brownian noise, quenched for the entire trajectory, nonconstant, and bounded away from both zero and infinity.
The target is an absorbing origin on a one-dimensional half-line; comparison is to constant arithmetic-mean diffusivity.
Infinite mean first-passage times are not compared. Time-fluctuating, heavy-tailed, or vanishing diffusivities are not covered.
Novelty checked against inspected primary sources and published research records, not independently audited or guaranteed exhaustive.
title: Exactly one cumulative crossing and two density crossings for heterogeneous Brownian first passage
